newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cuts internal coffee price by 3.27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cuts internal coffee price by 3.27 pct.

text.p: Colombia cut its internal price by an additional 3.27 percent Friday, setting it at 380,500 pesos per 125-kg load, the National Coffee Growers' Federation said.
The price cut was the fifth since Jan. 31, when a new sliding-scale formula was introduced to adjust prices on a weekly basis and allow them to better track world market prices.

The latest drop in the internal price followed last week's steep 11.6 percent cut in the price paid to Colombian growers. It was based on the lowest average trading price for Colombian coffee in New York over the past week, which the federation said was $2.24 per pound.
